title: The party mandate 1996-1998
authors: Thomson, R., Rijksuniversiteit Groningen, Fac. PPSW, ICS (primary investigator)
contributors: W.H. van Schuur, Fac. PPSW, Vakgroep Sociologie, RU Groningen (depositor)
descriptions: In this study, the election programmes of four major Dutch political parties, PvdA, D66, CDA and VVD, were examined. The election programmes studied relate to the parliamentary elections of 1986, 1989 and 1994.
